analyzer.name: Lucene Nori
analyzer.input: Full original chunk or full original question, including spaces, punctuation and prefixes
analyzer.preserve: All other Hangul lexical forms including MAG, MAJ, MM, XPN, XSA, XSN, XSV, verbs/adjectives and unknown words. Keep dictionary-recognized compound original and components. No guarantee of semantic disambiguation.
analyzer.ascii: Ignore Nori ASCII outputs; append original regex [a-zA-Z0-9]+ lowercase to preserve existing ASCII and number multiplicities.
analyzer.length: All emitted token occurrences counted, including mixed-mode overlaps; legacy rank_bm25 bag-of-words length, not full Lucene similarity.

idf.fit_scope: All16051 chunks before explicit receipt filter

fixed.bm25: Only predeclared tokenizer and IDF vary; fit full corpus; k1,b,scope fixed
fixed.scope: Original explicit report receipt; no query-derived filter
fixed.rrf: Same equal-weight RRF60 and tie ordering
fixed.packet: Final12 original whole chunks, same metadata, 65536 UTF-8 bytes; no refill, compression or caption attachment

evaluation: Same frozen10 answerable/26 required-unit panel,2 unscored refusals; all77 source/citation and packet audit. Review missing known witnesses for alternatives. No answer accuracy or refusal score.
success_gate: Synthetic boundary/compound/polarity/ASCII contracts must pass before corpus run. For retrieval follow-up candidate: preserve every baseline-covered unit, recover >=1 missing unit, and no confirmed new required-source regression in reviewed historical-citation loss cases. Do not activate runtime automatically.
stop: No dictionary/POS/IDF retuning after benchmark scoring; no retry of crashed scored run; failed synthetic gate stops scoring.
limitations: Development-exposed77, curated26 units and same-assistant unblinded source review. Nori package changes segmentation, compound expansion and POS filtering jointly; 2x2 isolates package vs IDF, not each linguistic choice. No full-Lucene reproduction or held-out generalization.
